title: fusion.workflow/v1
description: A workflow definition, catalog/workflows/<id>.v1.json, copied unchanged into the bundle as workflows/<id>.v1.json. The five keys are exactly the ones Prior reads (internal/fusionhost/external_catalog.go at 8bab88a, DisallowUnknownFields and an exact key count); a step's input_from and completion are free objects to Prior, which requires them non-empty, so the hand-over and the completion condition are stated there. revise_bound N is the maximum number of revisions after the initial attempt: N permits at most N+1 attempts, each on one host-provisioned run whose attempt map the host allocates and persists before dispatch (Prior answer 67.5). requires lists the host services the workflow calls; Prior compares it with the exact service map before starting the process and refuses on any absence (67.6). The module performs no preflight of its own: the module API's HostCaller exposes CallHost only, and no claim of a module-side check is made here or in the adapter. Rules JSON Schema cannot check and the catalog tests enforce: every step role resolves in the catalog to a role whose prior state is not unsupported, and every host_service appears in requires.

capability.description: The module capability this workflow serves under module.invoke.

step.description: Exactly one of role (a catalog role the step dispatches) and host_service (a host capability the step calls). A host_service step may take its role from the invocation: workflows/entry.v1.json's run step calls host.role.run.v1 and names its role in input_from as the invocation's entry profile, resolved through the catalog's entries, because a generic workflow has no fixed role.

input_from.description: The hand-over: where the step's input comes from and which schema binds it.

completion.description: The condition under which the step is complete.
